views.front: Image 1 is a 3D render of Rosa, a fictional professional female MMA fighter (not a real or famous person), standing in an A-pose. Image 2 is a close-up of her face for identity only. Redraw image 1 as a photorealistic full-body studio photograph of exactly the same woman: same face, same dark brown hair pulled back in a tight braid, same lean, visibly muscular fighter's physique with defined shoulders, arms, six-pack abs and powerful legs, same proportions. Same outfit: plain solid black racerback sports top, plain solid teal (#0f7c80) MMA fight shorts with a plain black waistband, black open-finger 4oz MMA gloves, barefoot. POSE IS CRITICAL, copy image 1's A-pose exactly: she stands straight facing the camera, feet shoulder-width apart, and BOTH ARMS ARE STRAIGHT AND RAISED OUT TO THE SIDES at about 45 degrees from her body, like a 3D-scanning A-pose mannequin, so there is a wide gap of empty white background between each arm and her torso and the fists are far outside the hips at upper-thigh height. The arms must not hang down by her sides. Both hands are clenched about 60% into a firm, partly closed fist inside the open-finger gloves: fingers curled toward the palm, fingertips not yet pressed into the palm, thumb resting along the index finger. Expression: a pronounced, determined, confident smirk: the left corner of her closed mouth is clearly pulled up and the right corner stays level, a slight crease beside the raised corner, no teeth, steady intense eyes looking straight into the camera, brows slightly lowered. Natural skin texture and realistic muscle definition. No logos, text or graphics anywhere. Full body visible head to feet, centered, plain white background, even soft studio lighting, photorealistic, sharp focus.
